_doc: Vehicles / OEMs — automakers and EV makers. Keyed by cleaned-name token; see ENRICHMENT_PROMPT.md.

ford.one_liner: US OEM; BlueOval SK (with SK On) and BlueOval City.

general motors.one_liner: US OEM; Ultium platform & Ultium Cells JV with LGES.

volkswagen.one_liner: OEM group; PowerCo cell unit and unified prismatic cell.

nio.one_liner: Chinese premium EV maker; pioneer of battery swapping (Power Swap).

rivian.one_liner: US EV maker of pickup trucks and delivery vans; Amazon is an early investor and customer.

lucid motors.one_liner: US luxury EV maker, majority-owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.

stellantis.one_liner: Automaker group formed from the merger of Fiat Chrysler and PSA (Jeep, Ram, Peugeot, Fiat, Citroën, Opel).

bmw group.one_liner: German automaker; investor/partner in Solid Power and Our Next Energy for future cell technology.

toyota motor.one_liner: Japanese automaker; Prime Planet Energy & Solutions cell JV with Panasonic, also developing solid-state batteries.

hyundai motor.one_liner: Korean automaker group (incl. Kia); invested in SES AI and Factorial Energy for next-gen cells.

nissan motor.one_liner: Japanese automaker, part of the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi Alliance; its former battery arm became Envision AESC.

kia.one_liner: Korean automaker, part of Hyundai Motor Group, pursuing a distinct EV product strategy.

honda motor.one_liner: Japanese automaker; battery joint venture with LG Energy Solution in Ohio, USA.

mercedes-benz group.one_liner: German automaker; co-owner of the ACC cell joint venture and a Factorial Energy solid-state partner.

saic motor.one_liner: Chinese state-owned automaker; joint ventures with Volkswagen and General Motors in China.

geely auto.one_liner: Chinese automaker group; owns Volvo, Polestar and the Zeekr EV brand.

polestar.one_liner: Swedish EV brand spun out of Volvo, majority-owned by Geely.

fisker.one_liner: US EV startup that filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in June 2024 after production and demand problems.

vinfast.one_liner: Vietnamese EV maker owned by conglomerate Vingroup.

great wall motor.one_liner: Chinese automaker; ORA and Haval EV brands.

renault group.one_liner: French automaker, part of the Renault-Nissan-Mitsubishi Alliance; Ampere is its EV division, backer of Verkor.

xpeng.one_liner: Chinese EV maker known for advanced driver-assistance technology.

li auto.one_liner: Chinese EV maker specializing in extended-range electric vehicles (EREVs).

faraday future.one_liner: US EV startup that has faced persistent production and funding struggles.

canoo.one_liner: US EV startup building commercial and lifestyle vehicles, with ongoing financial struggles.

arrival.one_liner: UK/US EV van startup that delisted and filed for bankruptcy in 2024.

lordstown motors.one_liner: US EV truck startup (Endurance pickup) that filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2023.
